value.rationale: The model was introduced specifically to represent reversals between magnetic-mode states, so the relative stationary energy of the D and Q modes is a natural physical invariant rather than an arbitrary slice. The exact RMS ratio is independent of which periodic or chaotic recurrent component carries the statistics, giving a stringent normalization and simulation/measurement consistency check. The three variance defects go beyond the integrated balance by quantifying precisely how much product-fluctuation variance is unresolved dynamical activity in each coordinate. This is a structural stationary-statistics result for the model, not a parameter renaming or a recomputation of a known table.
